description: VN→ZH classifier over-generalization (杯 family): Vietnamese learners default to 个, but a drink served in a cup/glass (茶/水/咖啡/酒/牛奶/果汁) takes 杯. Rule zh-ge-to-bei rewrites 个 → 杯 for a closed drink noun.
fp_risk_note: Low risk. Rewrites 个 → 杯 only before a closed cup/glass-drink noun (茶/水/咖啡/酒/牛奶/果汁) after a number/demonstrative. Non-drink senses and compounds (水果/水平, 酒吧/酒店, 茶馆/茶叶) are guarded by tail lookaheads so only the drink-in-a-cup reading matches.

positive.notes: 一个咖啡 → 一杯咖啡.
一个水 → 一杯水 (drink sense).

negative.notes: 水果 (fruit) genuinely takes 个 — 水 is not the drink head, the 果 tail lookahead guards it, must abstain.
酒吧 (bar) — 酒 is not the drink-in-a-cup head, the 吧 tail lookahead guards it, must abstain.
